relations.text: 子会社NIPSCOがAmazon Data Servicesにデータセンター用の電気を供給する契約(2025年9月)。親会社Amazonが支払いを保証
relations.text_en: Its NIPSCO unit agreed in September 2025 to supply electricity to Amazon Data Services' data centers, with Amazon.com guaranteeing payment

source.label: NiSource 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In September 2025, NIPSCO entered into an agreement with ADS, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., under which NIPSCO will provide electricity to ADS' data centers.

relations.text: 発電子会社やNIPSCOの少数持ち分をBlackstone系の投資家に売り、資本を入れた
relations.text_en: Sold minority stakes in its generation unit and NIPSCO to Blackstone-affiliated investors

source.label: NiSource 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Blackstone Investor pursuant to a purchase and sale agreement entered into in October 2025, that offered equity interests in Generation Holdings II in exchange for capital contributions by the parties.
